posts.author: Gagan_suryaputra
posts.text: 16 IPOs. ₹7,100 crore in one week — The week starting September 7 has 16 IPOs, including 11 mainboard issues, seeking to raise more than ₹7,100 crore. Six mainboard IPOs are scheduled to open on September 9 alone. That’s a lot of fresh equity supply competing for the same pool of investor capital. One thing to find out is: Will this be ₹7,100 crore of fresh money entering the market, or ₹7,100 crore being pulled out of existing stocks and redirected into IPOs? Source: IPO rush continues: 16 companies to raise over Rs 7,190 crore this week - The Economic Times
